name: Asep Medical Holdings Inc
summary: Asep Medical Holdings Inc. is dedicated to advancing medical solutions, primarily through its subsidiary, ASEP Medical Inc. The company's core focus involves pioneering an early diagnostic method for Sepsis, as well as developing innovative peptide-based therapeutic treatments applicable to a variety of medical conditions. Established in 2020, this Vancouver, Canada-based firm was formerly known as Trenchant Life Sciences Investment Corp. before adopting its present identity.
